I built a machine learning model to predict the outcomes of MLB games in a profitable way! I introduced my model on this page, but today is time to actually show you how it’s done so far. So far this season we are up over 5% on the bets. It’s been as high as 7% but with a bad luck streak recently we fell to 5% which is still amazing 🚀

It’s very difficult to beat the books less than 5% of people who try can actually beat the sports books so I’m very happy with this result, where my model is actually making money💸
